name: TransFER
authors_or_creators: Fanglei Xue, Qiangchang Wang, Guodong Guo (Institute of Deep Learning, Baidu Research; National Engineering Laboratory for Deep Learning Technology and Application, Beijing, China)
publication_venue: ICCV 2021 (IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision)
accuracy_rafdb: 90.91% Overall accuracy on RAF-DB basic 7-class subset
hardware_requirements: Training on NVIDIA GPUs (Tesla V100 class typical for ICCV 2021 ViT-hybrid models); inference feasible on a single modern GPU [uncertain]
loss_function: Standard softmax cross-entropy classification loss combined with Multi-Attention Dropping (MAD) and Multi-head Self-Attention Dropping (MSAD) regularization to enforce diverse attention
training_data_used: RAF-DB, AffectNet, FERPlus (fine-tuning); IR-50 backbone pretrained on MS-Celeb-1M
pretraining_strategy: face-recognition-pretrain (IR-50 backbone pretrained for face recognition on MS-Celeb-1M)
robustness: Designed implicitly for robustness via MAD/MSAD encouraging diverse attention regions (mitigates overfitting to single facial parts under occlusion/pose); explicit Occlusion-RAF-DB / Pose-RAF-DB numbers not reported [uncertain]
explainability: Attention map visualization supported (multi-head self-attention maps from the Transformer encoder)
